**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 11.1, ¶p0045).**

- **Issue:** § 11.1 mandates immediate discontinuation of all assistance and permanent deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support — squarely in the playbook's walk-away territory, and short of even the 90-day fallback.
- **Internal conflict:** It contradicts § 11.2 (30-day return in a commonly used, machine-readable format), § 11.3 (deletion only after Customer confirms return, with officer certification), and the "agreed transition period" referenced in § 10.1.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** § 11.1 replaced with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, including export and migration support, and deletion subordinated to §§ 11.2–11.3. Because 11.2–11.3 already deliver the preferred return and certified-deletion mechanics, this single paragraph swap is the smallest edit that reaches the preferred position; the comment offers 90 days as a fallback.
